# Security policy

This policy applies to every MkDocs NG repository that does not have a
`SECURITY.md` of its own.

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest release of each package and ship as a new
release. Older releases are not patched.

| Package | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| `mkdocs-ng` | latest release |
| `mkdocs-sumi` | latest release |
| `mkdocs-ng-material` | latest release |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue, pull request or discussion for a security
problem.

Report it privately on GitHub instead: open the **Security** tab of the
affected repository and click **Report a vulnerability**. Include the package
and version, the steps to reproduce it, and what an attacker could do with it.

## What to expect

- An acknowledgement within a few days.
- A fix in a new release, and a published security advisory.
- Credit in the advisory, unless you prefer not to be named.
